data.speaker: Gardener
data.text:
Oh, a visitor. How lovely.
Welcome to my garden — though I suppose it's been autumn here for some time now.
I am Elara. I tend to what remains.
Things still grow here, if you encourage them properly.

choices.text: I'm looking for a cabinet key.

data.speaker: Gardener
data.text: Is there something I can help you with, dear?

data.speaker: Gardener
data.text:
It used to be full of roses along the east wall. Three of them in particular — deep red, always in bloom.
When the curse came, they went into the display case as if to preserve themselves.
I've missed them terribly. But you were asking about something else?

data.speaker: Gardener
data.text:
Yes, I have it. Edmund gave it to me once — a long time ago now.
I still do.
But the garden has been missing something. Perhaps we can help each other.

data.speaker: Gardener
data.text:
Edmund sent you?
*a small quiet pause*
He still thinks of the key, then.

data.speaker: Gardener
data.text:
Three red roses — they're in the old display case in the east room.
The case has three weighted panels. You'll need something heavy on each one at the same time to release the latch.
Have a look around the room for what's there.
Bring all three roses back here and I'll give you the key.

data.speaker: Gardener
data.text:
Edmund sent you?
*a small quiet pause*
He still thinks of the key, then.
Three red roses — east room display case. Three weighted panels, all at once to open it.
Bring them here and I'll give you the key.

data.speaker: Gardener
data.text:
You have {item_count:item=Rose|round} of 3 roses so far.
The display case is in the east room — three weighted panels, all pressed at the same time.
Find something heavy for each one and they'll all release together.

data.speaker: Gardener
data.text:
Three roses. Oh, they're perfect.
*she cups them gently*
They smell exactly as they should. Some things the curse couldn't touch after all.

data.speaker: Gardener
data.text:
Here — the cabinet key.
Tell Edmund the garden is blooming again.
He used to say that's all anything needed — the right conditions, and a little patience.

data.speaker: Gardener
data.text:
The roses are back where they belong.
Help Edmund find what he's looking for.
He always worked so hard. He deserved better than all this.
